ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Depths of Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope and scale of Medicaid fraud, including the Feeding Our Future and autism fraud schemes
ideas.angle: Investigative reporting, following the money trail
questions: What are the most common schemes?
How can the government prevent and detect Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: By following the money trail and investigating the scope and scale of Medicaid fraud, we can uncover the depths of this issue and identify potential solutions
